title: Table native coverage audit
scope: T01-T07 only; 14 direct Table controls plus Advanced/Visibility/condition behavior.
coverage_policy: Rows are marked evidenced only from candidate82 native records. This is bounded representative coverage, not an exhaustive arbitrary-value, position, Motion, State, or runtime-control claim.

dom_assertions: caption Workshop schedule; heading-on output has thead > tr > th[scope=col] and tbody rows; heading-off mobile output has 9 cells and zero headings.
cases.reload_devices: Heading/caption proof repeats at 1280, 834, and 414px; no-heading edge proof is Mobile-only.
limits: No-heading branch has only Mobile proof in this record.

dom_assertions: Both headings produce col and row scoped TH cells at all devices; row-only Mobile proof produces row TH; one-row, blank-cell, uneven-row, and empty Rows cases are recorded.
cases.reload_devices: Both-heading proof covers all three devices; row-only and edge-row proof is Mobile-only.
limits: Empty Rows omits the public table while the editor retains a selectable placeholder; edge-row records are Mobile-only.

dom_assertions: Lines options are Between rows, Full grid, and None; zebra shading applies to alternate body rows in style proof.
computed_assertions: Corrected rows probe reads the between-row rule on tbody tr cell top border: 1px solid rgb(180,95,60) on the second row; earlier first-row/bottom probe is rejected.
cases.reload_devices: All three line variants reload at all three devices; corrected border probe covers all three devices.
limits: The corrected between-row selector interpretation supersedes the misleading edge probe.

dom_assertions: Header and body cell text/spacing values remain associated with the Table DOM and caption survives.
computed_assertions: Authored proof: Desktop/Tablet 18px, 12px padding, text rgb(36,52,71); Mobile 14px, 8px 10px padding; header/background/line values are recorded in the combined style proof.
cases.reload_devices: Computed style proof covers all three devices.
limits: The new-table Mobile defaults 14px and 8px 10px are authored DEF defaults/source context, while this record proves the authored/reloaded values; do not call the defaults a separate native test.

cases.purpose: conditional heading, zebra, and caption styles
dom_assertions: When enabled, header background/text, alternate-row shading, and caption color are visible in computed records; when heading/zebra/caption prerequisites are off, all four conditional controls are absent and public output has no heading/caption/shade.
computed_assertions: Header bg rgb(229,239,216), heading color rgb(32,80,128), zebra rgb(245,213,148), caption rgb(116,53,34).
cases.reload_devices: Enabled style proof covers all devices; conditional-controls-off proof is Mobile-only.
limits: Conditional controls off matrix is Mobile-only.

dom_assertions: No overflow at any responsive width.
computed_assertions: Override: D 18px/12px/rgb(36,52,71), T 16px/10px/rgb(48,72,96), M 13px/6px/rgb(24,56,72). Reset: all devices inherit D 18px/12px/rgb(36,52,71).
cases.reload_devices: Override and reset records cover 1280, 834, and 414px.

dom_assertions: table-proof wrapper id/classes/outline survive all devices; breakpoint hide uses display:none with table retained; condition non-match omits wrapper/table/caption while match keeps all three.
computed_assertions: Identity record targets DIV.pagecraft-table-wrap; visibility matrix covers each selected device; Always show restoration was reloaded before final condition proof.
cases.reload_devices: Identity, visibility, and match/non-match condition records cover all three devices.
limits: Position, max width, overflow, and shared Motion/State controls were not covered; condition-control accessible labels remain a separate native verification item.

scope_gaps: No exhaustive arbitrary rows, values, fonts, positions, max widths, overflow settings, or shared Motion/State controls.
T02 edge rows and T05 conditional-controls-off proof are Mobile-only, as recorded.
T03 initial edge probe was corrected to tbody tr cell top border; the rejected probe is not used as evidence.
Visibility retains DOM while hidden; condition non-match omits the rendered wrapper/table/caption branch.
